help.heroHint: Tap a category to see questions

account.title: Account & Login
account.q1: How can I change my password?
account.a1: Go to Settings > Change Password, enter your current password and set a new one.
account.q2: I can't log in to my account, what should I do?
account.a2: Check your email address. If you forgot your password, use the 'Forgot Password' option or contact support.
account.q3: How do I update my profile information?
account.a3: Go to Settings > Edit Profile to update your name, surname and phone number.

vehicles.title: Vehicles & Tracking
vehicles.q1: How can I see my vehicle's location?
vehicles.a1: You can see your vehicle's real-time location on the Dashboard map. Location updates every 5 seconds.
vehicles.q2: My vehicle appears offline, what should I do?
vehicles.a2: Check the GPS device power connection. Inspect the LED indicators on the device. Verify the internet connection.
vehicles.q3: Can I track multiple vehicles at once?
vehicles.a3: Yes, you can see all your vehicles on the Live Map screen in the Admin panel.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.q1: How do I accept a task assigned to me?
tasks.a1: View the incoming task on Dashboard and press 'Accept'. Use 'Start Task' to begin the task.
tasks.q2: How do I mark a task as completed?
tasks.a2: Go to task details and press 'Complete Task'. Fill in the required information and confirm.
tasks.q3: Can I reject an assigned task?
tasks.a3: Yes, view the incoming task and use the 'Reject' option. You will be asked to provide a reason.

technical.title: Technical Support
technical.q1: How do I set up the GPS device?
technical.a1: Connect the device to the vehicle USB port. Scan the QR code in the mobile app and complete WiFi configuration via BLE.
technical.q2: The device can't connect to WiFi, what should I do?
technical.a2: Make sure you're using a 2.4GHz WiFi network (5GHz not supported). Check the password. Restart the device and connect within 60 seconds.
technical.q3: What do the LED lights mean?
technical.a3: Solid green: System running. Blinking blue: BLE mode. Yellow: Searching GPS. Red: Error. See LED Indicators page for details.

privacy.s1Body: TulipFleet ("we", "our", "us") operates a fleet management platform including mobile applications and IoT devices. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable data protection laws.
privacy.s2Body:
We collect the following categories of data:

• Account Information: Name, email address, phone number, company name
• Vehicle Data: License plate, brand, model, fuel type, mileage
• Location Data: Real-time GPS coordinates from IoT devices installed in vehicles
• Driving Data: Speed, acceleration events, braking patterns, route history
• Device Data: ESP32 device identifiers, firmware version, connectivity status
• Usage Data: App usage patterns, feature interactions, login timestamps
privacy.s3Body:
Your data is used for:

• Fleet Management: Real-time vehicle tracking, route optimization, task assignment
• Safety Monitoring: Detecting hard braking, acceleration, and impact events
• Reporting: Generating fleet performance reports, fuel consumption analytics
• Communication: Push notifications for task updates, alerts, and system messages
• Service Improvement: Analyzing usage patterns to improve the platform
privacy.s4Body:
• All data is stored on secure servers located within the European Union (Hetzner, Germany)
• Data transmission is encrypted using TLS/SSL
• MQTT communication uses TLS encryption
• Passwords are hashed using bcrypt
• JWT tokens are used for authentication with automatic expiry
• Location data is retained for 7 days, then automatically purged
• Regular security audits and penetration testing are conducted
privacy.s5Body:
We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Data may be shared with:

• Your Company Admin: Fleet managers can view vehicle and driver data within their organization
• Google Maps API: For route calculation and map display (anonymized)
• Firebase: For push notification delivery
• Legal Requirements: When required by law or legal proceedings
privacy.s6Body:
Under GDPR, you have the right to:

• Access: Request a copy of your personal data
• Rectification: Correct inaccurate personal data
• Erasure: Request deletion of your personal data
• Portability: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
• Restriction: Restrict the processing of your data
• Objection: Object to data processing based on legitimate interests

To exercise these rights, contact us at: destek@tulipfleet.com
